`afraid` sıfatı `of` ile bağlanır ve ardından `-ing` gelir: `afraid of saying no`. Başka bir edat bu kalıbı bozar.
`longer` bir karşılaştırma biçimidir ve karşılaştırılan şey `than` ile bağlanır: «The list is longer than it looks».
`depend` fiili `on` edatını alır: `depends on one person`. Başka edatlarla bu fiil kurulmaz.

parts.instruction: This part has four tasks. You hear short extracts, conversations, some information and an interview. You hear every recording twice.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde dört görev var. Kısa parçalar, konuşmalar, bir bilgilendirme ve bir söyleşi dinleyeceksin. Her kaydı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

tasks.prompt: You hear seven short extracts. Choose a, b or c. You hear every extract twice.
tasks.promptTr: Yedi kısa parça dinleyeceksin. a, b ya da c'yi seç. Her parçayı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Bir sorumlu tamir akşamı için ileti bırakıyor.

segments.text: Hello, this is about Thursday. The repair evening is still on, but we are in room two and not in the hall, because the hall floor is being done. Same time, six to nine. Bring the radio and I will look at it myself.

texts.situation: Biri ödev kulübünde gönüllü olmak istiyor.

segments.text: I would like to help with the homework club.
Lovely. There is a police check first and we pay for it, but it takes about three weeks.
So I cannot start on Monday?
Not this Monday, no.

texts.situation: Bahçe grubuna kapanışta anons yapılıyor.

segments.text: Before you all go: the garden tools are still in the green box, but the key has moved. It is not under the third stone any more. It hangs on a hook inside the shed door.

texts.situation: İki arkadaş bir toplantıdan söz ediyor.

segments.text: Did you go to the meeting?
Two hours, and we decided nothing.
Again?
We agreed to meet in three weeks with the same paper. I could have moved that shelf myself in ten minutes.

texts.situation: Danışma masası için tercüman soruluyor.

segments.text: Do you have somebody who speaks Arabic on Thursday mornings?
Thursday, yes, but only until eleven.
My appointment is at half past eleven.
Then I would move the appointment rather than the interpreter.

texts.situation: Bir sorumlu gönüllü sayısını anlatıyor.

segments.text: People ask how many volunteers we have. The number of names on the list is ninety-four. The number who did anything at all last month is thirty-one. I give the second number, because the first one has never once been true.

texts.situation: Biri cumartesi için ileti bırakıyor.

segments.text: Hi, it is about Saturday. I said I would drive, but my car is at the garage until Tuesday. I can still come; I just cannot bring anybody with me. Tell Selma, so she can ask somebody else.

items.explain: İleti tek değişikliği veriyor: «we are in room two and not in the hall». Saat ve gün duruyor: «Same time, six to nine».
Görevli süreyi veriyor: «There is a police check first … but it takes about three weeks». Ücreti kulüp ödüyor: «we pay for it».

options: A new box for the tools
items.explain: Anons yeri değiştiriyor: «It is not under the third stone any more. It hangs on a hook inside the shed door». Yeşil kutu aynı yerde.

items.text: How does the second speaker feel?
options: Pleased that a decision was made
Worried about the state of the shelf
items.explain: Konuşmacı sonucu ve kendi ölçütünü veriyor: «Two hours, and we decided nothing» ve «I could have moved that shelf myself in ten minutes».

items.text: What does the second speaker advise?
options: To change the time of the appointment
To come on a different day
items.explain: Öğüt tek cümlede: «I would move the appointment rather than the interpreter». Perşembe uygun gün, sorun saatin on biri geçmesi.

items.text: Which number does the speaker use?
options: The number of people who were active
The number of names on the list
items.explain: Konuşmacı seçimini gerekçelendiriyor: «I give the second number», yani geçen ay bir şey yapan otuz bir kişi. Listedeki doksan dört için «has never once been true» diyor.

options: She has to work on Saturday
She can come but not drive
items.explain: İleti ikisini ayırıyor: «I can still come; I just cannot bring anybody with me». Araba salıya kadar serviste.

tasks.prompt: You hear six short conversations. What is the main point? Choose a, b or c. You hear every conversation twice.
tasks.promptTr: Altı kısa konuşma dinleyeceksin. Ana nokta nedir? a, b ya da c'yi seç. Her konuşmayı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: İki komşu panodaki notları konuşuyor.

segments.text: I put a note up in March offering to help with the shopping. Nothing happened.
Nobody at all?
Then in June I wrote: Tuesday at four, I will be by the door with a trolley. Three people came. Same offer, one difference.

texts.situation: İki gönüllü reddedilen bir teklifi konuşuyor.

segments.text: He offered twenty hours a week and she said no.
I would have taken it.
He did the same at the school last year. Six weeks, then nothing, and they had built the timetable round him.
All right, that is fair. Two hours that keep going is worth more.

texts.situation: Biri kendisine yapılan bir çağrıya karşılık veriyor.

segments.text: That is kind of you to think of me, and I have to say no this time. I did the Christmas one and I was no use to my family for two weeks. Ask me again in March and the answer will probably be different.

texts.situation: İki komşu koridordaki rafı konuşuyor.

segments.text: Somebody left a bag of tomatoes on Friday.
And?
They were still there on Monday and now the whole shelf smells. It is not that people are careless. It is that nobody owns the shelf between Friday and Sunday.

texts.situation: İki kişi bahçe grubunun düzenini tartışıyor.

segments.text: You cannot run a group with no list.
We have run it for six years.
What if nobody comes?
Then whoever is there waters the beds, or nobody waters them for a week and nothing dies. A list would give us names and the same four people.

texts.situation: İki kişi bir yanlış anlamayı düzeltiyor.

segments.text: Runa said you might take over the driving.
I have not said yes.
She said you would.
I said I would come on Tuesday and sit in the car. That is not the same sentence.

items.text: What is the first speaker doing?
options: Asking for a lift to the shops
items.explain: Konuşmacı iki notu karşılaştırıp farkı adlandırıyor: «Same offer, one difference» — ikincisi gün ve saat veriyor. Komşulardan yakınma yok.

items.text: What do the speakers agree about in the end?
options: Twenty hours a week is a generous offer
Steady help is worth more than a large offer
items.explain: İkinci konuşmacı fikrini değiştirip özetliyor: «Two hours that keep going is worth more». Başta o kişi teklifi kabul ederdi.
Konuşmacı reddediyor ama kapıyı kapatmıyor: «I have to say no this time … Ask me again in March». Bilgi istemiyor, karar da eleştirmiyor.

options: The people who use the shelf are careless
Fresh food does not work on the shelf
The shelf should be taken away completely
items.explain: Konuşmacı ilk şıkkı kendisi eliyor: «It is not that people are careless». Sorun cuma ile pazar arasında rafa kimsenin bakmaması, yani bozulan yiyecek orada duramıyor.

items.text: What is the second speaker doing?
options: Defending a group that keeps no list
Asking somebody to join the group
Suggesting that they write a list
items.explain: Konuşmacı listesizliği savunuyor: «We have run it for six years» ve «A list would give us names and the same four people».

items.text: What does the second speaker want?
options: To be paid for the fuel
To try the work before deciding
items.explain: Konuşmacı sözünün sınırını çiziyor: «I said I would come on Tuesday and sit in the car. That is not the same sentence».

tasks.prompt: You hear information about a volunteer day. Complete the notes, questions 14 to 19. Write ONE or TWO words or a number in each gap. You hear the information twice.
tasks.promptTr: Bir gönüllü günü hakkında bilgi dinleyeceksin. 14–19. maddelerdeki notları tamamla. Her boşluğa BİR ya da İKİ sözcük veya bir sayı yaz. Kaydı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Bir sorumlu gönüllü gününü anlatıyor.

segments.text: Good evening. The volunteer day is on Saturday the eighteenth. We start at nine in the car park, not at the main door. There are three jobs: the river path, the hallway shelf and the homework room. The river path group needs boots; we have gloves for everybody. Lunch is at one and it is free. If you are coming, tell Selma by Wednesday, because she orders the food.

texts.title: Volunteer day — notes

items.explain: Kayıt «on Saturday the eighteenth» diyor. Not kâğıdında `Saturday the` basılı olduğu için boşluğa yalnız gün yazılır.
Kayıt buluşma yerini karşıtıyla veriyor: «in the car park, not at the main door». Ana kapı bilerek elenen yer.
Kayıt sayıyı verip sayıyor: «There are three jobs: the river path, the hallway shelf and the homework room».
Kayıt getirileni ve verileni ayırıyor: «The river path group needs boots; we have gloves for everybody». Eldiven istenmiyor çünkü sağlanıyor.
«Lunch is at one and it is free» — yemek saati. Dokuz buluşma saati, on sekiz ise ayın günü.
Kayıt son günü gerekçesiyle veriyor: «tell Selma by Wednesday, because she orders the food». Cumartesi etkinliğin kendi günü.

tasks.prompt: You hear an interview with a woman who organises volunteers. Choose a, b or c for questions 20 to 25. You hear the interview twice.
tasks.promptTr: Gönüllüleri düzenleyen bir kadınla söyleşi dinleyeceksin. 20–25. maddeler için a, b ya da c'yi seç. Söyleşiyi iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Bir sunucu, gönüllüleri düzenleyen Noor ile konuşuyor.

segments.text: You have a reputation for turning people away. Is that fair?
It is not quite fair, but it is close. Last year I said no to about a third of the people who offered.
That sounds like a lot.

It is. In my first year I said yes to everybody, and I lost four evenings a week to people I never saw a second time. Somebody has to meet them, show them the work and check them. That work is real and nobody sees it.
So the cost of a new volunteer is your own time.

Yes, and I can put a number on it. Three hours before the person is any use at all. If they stay only six weeks, those hours will never come back. If they stay two years, they are the best three hours I ever spent.
And how do you know which is which?

I do not, and anybody who says they can is selling something. What I do instead is ask for something small and exact. Two hours on a Tuesday. The people who say anything, any time, are the ones who go.
That seems hard on somebody who really is free all week.
It is, and I get it wrong. A man last spring offered every day and I gave him Tuesdays only. He is still here, and he still tells me I was rude.
Would you change anything?

I would tell people why. For two years I said no and let them believe we were full. Now I say it straight: I want you for two years and not for six weeks, and the way to get two years is to start small.

items.text: What does Noor say about her reputation?
options: It is close to the truth
It only fitted her first year
She has never turned anybody away
items.explain: Noor itirazını sınırlıyor: «It is not quite fair, but it is close», sonra sayı veriyor: «about a third of the people who offered».

items.text: What happened in her first year?
options: She had far too few volunteers
She refused a third of the offers
Her own week filled up with new people
items.explain: Noor bedeli anlatıyor: «I said yes to everybody, and I lost four evenings a week to people I never saw a second time». Üçte bir reddi geçen yılın sayısı.

items.text: What number does she put on a new volunteer?
items.explain: Noor maliyeti sayıyla veriyor: «Three hours before the person is any use at all». Altı hafta ile iki yıl kalış süreleri, maliyet değil.

items.text: How does she decide who will stay?
options: She cannot, so she asks for something small
She uses a test that she developed herself
She takes only people with long experience
items.explain: Noor önce bilmediğini söylüyor: «I do not, and anybody who says they can is selling something», sonra yaptığını: «ask for something small and exact».

items.text: What does she say about the man who offered every day?
options: He left again after six weeks
She was right to give him Tuesdays
He stayed, but he has not forgiven her
items.explain: Noor sonucu ve süreni birlikte veriyor: «He is still here, and he still tells me I was rude». Kendi kararını da savunmuyor: «I get it wrong».

options: Say yes to a great many more people
Explain her reason for saying no
Stop asking people for two years
items.explain: Noor değiştireceği şeyi adlandırıyor: «I would tell people why. For two years I said no and let them believe we were full».

parts.instruction: This part has two tasks: an email and an article.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde iki görev var: bir e-posta ve bir yazı.

tasks.prompt: Three weeks ago you offered to help a local group and nobody has answered. Write an email to the group. Write about 100 words and cover all the points.
tasks.promptTr: Üç hafta önce yerel bir gruba yardım teklif ettin ve kimse cevap vermedi. Gruba bir e-posta yaz. Yaklaşık 100 kelime, bütün maddeleri işle.

points.de: Say when and how you offered to help.
points.tr: Ne zaman ve nasıl yardım teklif ettiğini söyle.

points.de: Offer one exact thing you can do, with a day and a time.
points.tr: Yapabileceğin tek bir somut şeyi gün ve saatiyle öner.

points.de: Say clearly what you cannot do.

rubric.sample:
Dear all,

On 3 October I filled in the form on your website and offered to help with the hallway shelf. I have not had an answer, which is fine — I know you are busy.

I would like to make the offer smaller and clearer. I can be at the building every Tuesday from five to seven. I can sort what is on the shelf, throw away what has gone off and write a list of what is missing.

I cannot drive and I cannot come at weekends, because I work on Saturdays.

If Tuesdays are no use, please tell me and I will not ask again.

Best wishes,
Ilja Berg
criteria: Üç içerik noktasının üçü de işlendi mi?
Teklif gün ve saat içeriyor mu? Belirsiz bir 'ne olursa yaparım' mı kalmış?
Yapılamayacak şey açıkça söylendi mi?
Present perfect doğru kullanıldı mı? (`I have not had an answer`)
Kayıt kibar ama sitem içermeyecek biçimde mi? Yaklaşık 100 kelime var mı?

tasks.prompt: Write an article for a local website with this title: "The smallest useful thing I have done for other people". Say what it was, how it started and what surprised you. Write about 100 words.
tasks.promptTr: Yerel bir internet sitesi için şu başlıkla bir yazı yaz: "Başkaları için yaptığım en küçük yararlı şey". Ne olduğunu, nasıl başladığını ve seni neyin şaşırttığını yaz. Yaklaşık 100 kelime.

points.de: Say what the small thing was.
points.tr: O küçük şeyin ne olduğunu söyle.

points.de: Say how it started.
Say what surprised you.

rubric.sample:
For two years I have taken the bins of the flat below mine out on a Sunday evening. That is the whole thing. It takes four minutes.

It started because I heard her fall in the hallway with the bag in her hand. I did not ask her; I just did it the next week, and she did not mention it either.

What surprised me was the effect on me rather than on her. Four minutes a week has made me somebody who knows which flats are empty in August. I did not know a single neighbour before, and I had lived here for nine years.
criteria: Üç içerik noktasının üçü de işlendi mi?
Anlatılan şey gerçekten küçük mü, yoksa görev yanlış mı okunmuş?
Başlangıç somut bir olayla mı anlatıldı?
Present perfect ve geçmiş zaman doğru ayrıldı mı?
Şaşırtan şey açıkça adlandırıldı mı? Yaklaşık 100 kelime var mı?

parts.instruction: This part has four tasks: an interview, a long turn, a task we do together, and a general conversation.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde dört görev var: söyleşi, tek başına konuşma, birlikte yapılan bir görev ve genel sohbet.

tasks.prompt: I ask you some questions about where you live and about helping other people.
tasks.promptTr: Sana yaşadığın yer ve başkalarına yardım etmek hakkında sorular soracağım.

exchange.de: Good afternoon. How well do you know the people who live near you?
exchange.tr: İyi günler. Yakınında oturanları ne kadar tanıyorsun?

exchange.hint: Durumu anlat ve bir örnek ver.
exchange.expect: bir durumu betimlemek ve somut bir örnekle desteklemek

exchange.de: Thank you. Has anybody ever helped you without being asked?
exchange.tr: Teşekkürler. Hiç kimse senden istenmeden yardım etti mi?

exchange.hint: Present perfect ya da geçmiş zamanla bir olay anlat.
exchange.expect: geçmişte olmuş tek bir olayı anlatmak

exchange.de: And if you had one free afternoon a week, who would you give it to?
exchange.tr: Haftada bir boş öğleden sonran olsa onu kime ayırırdın?

exchange.hint: Koşul kipiyle cevapla ve gerekçelendir.
exchange.expect: ikinci tip koşul cümlesiyle bir varsayım kurmak

points.de: describe a situation with an example
tell one event from the past
use a second conditional

rubric.sample: I know two families in my building and nobody else, although I have lived there for six years. Last winter the man upstairs took my post in for a week while I was away, and he never said anything about it; I found it on my door. If I had one free afternoon a week, I would give it to the homework club at the school, because that is the only work near me where somebody would actually notice if I stopped.
criteria: İlk cevapta somut bir örnek verildi mi?
Geçmişteki olay tek ve belirgin mi, yoksa genel mi kalmış?
Son cevapta ikinci tip koşul kuruldu mu?
Cevaplar geliştirildi mi, tek cümlede mi kaldı?

tasks.prompt: Talk on your own for about one minute. Compare these two ways of helping: giving money to an organisation every month, or giving two hours of your own time every week. Say which you would choose and why.
tasks.promptTr: Yaklaşık bir dakika tek başına konuş. Yardımın şu iki yolunu karşılaştır: her ay bir kuruluşa para vermek mi, yoksa her hafta kendi zamanından iki saat vermek mi? Hangisini seçeceğini ve nedenini söyle.

points.de: compare the two ways
say which you would choose and why
mention one disadvantage of your choice
points.tr: Seçtiğin yolun bir olumsuz yanını da söyle

rubric.sample: Money is easy to give and easy to stop, and nobody in the organisation ever learns your name. Time is the opposite: it is hard to give, and after a few months people expect you. On the other hand, money buys things that volunteers cannot buy, such as a van. I would give the two hours, mainly because I want to see what actually happens to what I give. The disadvantage is honest enough: I am worth about nine euros an hour to them, and my monthly payment would be worth more.
criteria: İki yol da gerçekten karşılaştırıldı mı?
Karşılaştırma yapıları kullanıldı mı? (on the other hand, the opposite)
Seçim gerekçelendirildi mi?
Seçilen yolun olumsuz yanı da söylendi mi?
Bir dakika kesintisiz konuşuldu mu?

tasks.prompt: Four of us have to look after the hallway shelf for one month. Talk with me and agree how we divide the weeks.
tasks.promptTr: Dördümüz bir ay boyunca koridordaki rafa bakmak zorundayız. Benimle konuş ve haftaları nasıl paylaşacağımıza karar ver.

exchange.de: There are four weeks and four of us, so one week each looks obvious. Do you agree?
exchange.tr: Dört hafta ve dört kişiyiz, herkese bir hafta düşmesi apaçık görünüyor. Katılıyor musun?

exchange.hint: Öneriye karşılık ver: kabul et ya da başka bir bölüşüm öner ve gerekçelendir.
exchange.expect: bir öneriye gerekçeli karşılık vermek

exchange.de: The problem is that two of us work at weekends, and the shelf is worst on a Sunday. How do we handle that?
exchange.tr: Sorun şu: ikimiz hafta sonu çalışıyoruz ve raf en çok pazar günü kötü oluyor. Bunu nasıl çözeriz?

exchange.hint: Somut bir çözüm öner ve karşı tarafın söylediğine gönderme yap.
exchange.expect: somut bir çözüm önermek ve karşı tarafın kısıtını hesaba katmak

exchange.de: All right. What do we write on the note for the others?
exchange.tr: Peki. Ötekiler için nota ne yazıyoruz?

exchange.hint: Vardığınız düzeni tek tek özetle.
exchange.expect: varılan düzeni açık ve sıralı biçimde özetlemek

points.de: respond to a proposal with a reason
solve a practical problem together
summarise the agreement

rubric.sample: One week each is fair on paper, but the weeks are not the same: the week after the food delivery is twice the work. You are right that Sunday is the problem, so let us split it: the two of you who work at weekends take the Monday to Friday jobs, and we two take the Sundays. On the note: weeks one and three, Tarek and me for Sundays; weeks two and four, you two; and everybody empties the shelf before they go on holiday.
criteria: İlk öneriye gerekçeli bir karşılık verildi mi?
Karşı tarafın kısıtı (hafta sonu çalışma) çözüme katıldı mı?
Somut bir bölüşüm ortaya çıktı mı?
Sonunda anlaşma özetlendi mi?

tasks.prompt: We talk a little more about the same topic: whether volunteers should be paid something.
tasks.promptTr: Aynı konu üzerine biraz daha konuşuyoruz: gönüllülere bir şey ödenmeli mi.

exchange.de: Some groups pay their volunteers' travel costs and nothing else. Is that enough?
exchange.tr: Bazı gruplar gönüllülerin yalnız yol parasını ödüyor. Bu yeterli mi?

exchange.hint: Görüşünü söyle ve bir örnek ver.
exchange.expect: genel bir soruya görüş bildirmek ve örneklendirmek

exchange.de: Other people say that as soon as you pay anything, it is a job with a bad salary. Would you agree?
exchange.tr: Kimileri de bir şey ödemeye başladığın anda bunun kötü maaşlı bir işe dönüştüğünü söylüyor. Katılır mısın?

exchange.hint: Kısmen katıl ya da karşı çık; iki yanı da anmaya çalış.
exchange.expect: bir iddiaya kısmen katılmak ya da karşı çıkmak, iki yanı da anmak

points.de: give an opinion with an example
agree or disagree in a nuanced way
points.tr: Katılırken ya da karşı çıkarken ince ayrım yapmak

rubric.sample: Travel money is not payment, it is simply not charging people for helping. A woman in our group spent eleven euros a week getting to the kitchen, which is a real cost and it stopped her coming. I partly agree with the other argument, because I have seen a group where the small payment became the reason people came, and the atmosphere changed within a year. But there is a difference between paying for a bus ticket and paying for an hour.
criteria: Görüş açıkça bildirildi mi?
Somut bir örnek verildi mi?
Kısmi katılım ifadeleri kullanıldı mı? (I partly agree, although)
İki yan da anıldı mı, yoksa tek yanlı mı kalındı?

parts.instruction: This part has six tasks. You read short texts, adverts, an article and three texts with gaps. Choose the correct answer for each question.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde altı görev var. Kısa metinler, ilanlar, bir yazı ve boşluklu üç metin okuyacaksın. Her soruda doğru cevabı işaretle.

tasks.prompt: Read the five texts and questions 1 to 5. Choose a, b or c.
tasks.promptTr: Beş metni ve 1–5. maddeleri oku. a, b ya da c'yi seç.

texts.title: The quiet room
texts.body: The quiet room is open from eight until midnight, every day. Phones must be on silent, and not face down on the table. If you need to take a call, the corridor is three metres away. We do not ask anybody to leave for a first phone call; we do ask for the second.

texts.title: From September
texts.body: Dear parents, from September phones go into a box at the door of every classroom and come out at the end of the lesson. This is not a punishment and it is not about trust. We tried asking the students to leave them in their bags, and that worked for about nine days.

texts.title: Seven to nine
texts.body: Mira, from now on I am turning my phone off between seven and nine every evening. If something is urgent, ring the flat phone; the number is on the fridge. Please do not read anything into this. It is not about you and I am not annoyed with anybody.

texts.title: What to bring
texts.body: Bring a notebook and a pen. We know that typing is faster; that is the problem. On this course you write by hand, badly and slowly, and we spend the last ten minutes of every session comparing what different people wrote down.

texts.title: Messages in the evening
texts.body: From Monday, nobody is expected to answer a message after six or before eight. If you like working in the evening, that is your business, but put the message in the box that sends it in the morning. Nobody should learn at ten at night that the rest of us are still working.

items.text: What happens after a second phone call in the room?
options: The person pays a small charge
The room is closed for the day
The person is asked to go
items.explain: Duyurunun son cümlesi ilkini bağışlayıp ikincisini bağışlamıyor: «We do not ask anybody to leave for a first phone call; we do ask for the second».

items.text: Why has the school changed the rule?
options: The students asked for a box
items.explain: E-posta önceki denemeyi ve ömrünü veriyor: «We tried asking the students to leave them in their bags, and that worked for about nine days».

items.text: What does the writer ask Mira to do?
options: Use another number in an emergency
items.explain: İleti tek bir yönerge taşıyor: «If something is urgent, ring the flat phone; the number is on the fridge». İleti göndermek yasaklanmıyor.

items.text: Why does the course ask for a pen?
options: There is no electricity in the room for typing
A notebook is cheaper than a laptop
Writing slowly is part of the method
items.explain: Duyuru hızı bir kusur olarak anıyor: «We know that typing is faster; that is the problem». Elektrik ya da fiyat gerekçe olarak hiç geçmiyor; defter zaten pahalılığı için değil, elle yazmak için isteniyor.

options: Answering a message the same evening
Evening work, if the message waits
Putting the work off until the next morning
items.explain: E-posta izni koşula bağlıyor: «If you like working in the evening, that is your business, but put the message in the box that sends it in the morning». Yani akşam çalışmak serbest, akşam cevap göndermek değil.

tasks.prompt: Read about five people, 6 to 10. Then read the eight adverts a to h. Which one is right for each person? You use each advert once only.
tasks.promptTr: 6–10. maddelerdeki beş kişiyi oku. Sonra a'dan h'ye sekiz ilanı oku. Her kişiye hangisi uyar? Her ilan en fazla bir kez kullanılır.

options.label: Quiet Room
options.body: Open eight until midnight, every day. Free with a library card. Phones on silent, no talking, no food.

options.label: Study Skills: One Hour, One Person
options.body: You bring two weeks of your own notes and somebody goes through them with you. Free, Thursday afternoons.

options.label: Typing Course
options.body: Six weeks, Tuesday evenings. Ten fingers and no looking at the keys. Twenty euros for the whole course.

options.label: Spoken Books
options.body: Thousands of titles read aloud. Listen in the car or in the kitchen. Free with a library card.

options.label: Parents' Evening Group
options.body: First Monday of the month. For parents of children aged ten to fourteen. No experts, only parents.

options.label: Homework Club
options.body: Monday to Thursday, four to seven, for children in years five to nine. Adults sit with them but do not do the work.

options.label: Reading Aloud at the Primary School
options.body: Volunteers needed for one hour a week. You read, the children listen and then they read to you.

options.label: Repair Evening
options.body: First Thursday of the month. Phones, radios and small machines. We tell you the price before we start.

items.text: Nadia wants to study in the evening but her flat is noisy and she has no money for a café.
items.explain: İlan üç koşulu birden karşılıyor: «Open eight until midnight», «Free with a library card» ve «no talking». Ücretsizlik burada belirleyici.

items.text: Ondrej reads slowly and would like to get through more books while he drives to work.
items.explain: İlan tam bu durumu anıyor: «Listen in the car or in the kitchen». Okumak yerine dinlemek sürüş sırasında tek seçenek.

items.text: Bexi wants her twelve-year-old to use a phone less and would like to talk to other parents.
items.explain: İlan hem yaş aralığını hem kimin geldiğini veriyor: «For parents of children aged ten to fourteen. No experts, only parents». On iki bu aralığın içinde.

items.text: Cato wants to learn to type properly because he is slow at work.
items.explain: İlan yöntemi adlandırıyor: «Ten fingers and no looking at the keys», altı hafta. Tamir akşamı (h) telefonları onarıyor, yazmayı öğretmiyor.

items.text: Lior wants somebody to look at the way he studies and tell him what he does wrong.
items.explain: İlan işi tarif ediyor: «You bring two weeks of your own notes and somebody goes through them with you». Sessiz oda (a) yalnız yer veriyor, geri bildirim vermiyor.

tasks.prompt: Read the article and questions 11 to 15. Choose a, b, c or d.
tasks.promptTr: Yazıyı ve 11–15. maddeleri oku. a, b, c ya da d'yi seç.

texts.title: Six weeks with a pen
texts.body:
I did not read a study. I ran a small one on myself, badly, and the result still changed what I do.

For six weeks I typed my notes in lectures, and for six weeks I wrote them by hand. Same course, same room, same three lectures a week. At the end of each block I took the same kind of short test, set by a friend who did not know which block was which.

Typing was better in every way I could measure at the time. I got down almost every word. My notes were tidy, easy to search and about four times longer.

The test told a different story. I scored higher after the handwritten block, and not by a little. What I think happened is this: by hand I could only get about half of it, so I had to decide what mattered while the speaker was still talking. That deciding is the work.

I want to be careful here. Twelve weeks is nothing, I am one person, and I knew what I was hoping for. If somebody typed the same notes and then spent ten minutes cutting them in half, they would probably get the same result without the sore hand.

So I have not stopped typing. I type in meetings, where I need the record, and I write by hand in anything I want to remember in a year.

options: She read several studies on the subject
She compared two ways over twelve weeks
She asked a friend to take notes for her
She took the same test every single week
items.explain: Yöntem ikinci paragrafta: «For six weeks I typed my notes in lectures, and for six weeks I wrote them by hand». Arkadaşın işi not tutmak değil, sınavı hazırlamak.

items.text: What was better about the typed notes?
options: They took much less time to write
They were much easier to remember
They were shorter and a great deal clearer
They were fuller and easier to search
items.explain: Metin üstünlüğü sayıyor: «My notes were tidy, easy to search and about four times longer». Yani daha kısa değil, daha uzunlar.

items.text: Why does the writer think handwriting worked better?
options: She had to choose what to write down
Her hand hurt, so she paid more attention
The lectures were slower in that block
She read the notes more often afterwards
items.explain: Yazar gerekçesini kendi adlandırıyor: «I had to decide what mattered while the speaker was still talking. That deciding is the work».

items.text: What does the writer say about her own experiment?
options: It proves that typing is always a mistake
The friend who set the test made an error
It is too small to prove anything
She would not be willing to run it again
items.explain: Beşinci paragraf çekinceleri sıralıyor: «Twelve weeks is nothing, I am one person, and I knew what I was hoping for».

options: She writes absolutely everything by hand
She has stopped taking notes altogether
She types and then reads the notes twice
She chooses the method to fit the situation
items.explain: Son cümle ikisini de yerinde tutuyor: «I type in meetings, where I need the record, and I write by hand in anything I want to remember in a year».

tasks.prompt: Read the text. One sentence is missing from each of the gaps 16 to 20. Which sentence a to f fits which gap? One sentence fits nowhere.
tasks.promptTr: Metni oku. 16–20. boşluklarda birer cümle eksik. a–f cümlelerinden hangisi hangi boşluğa uyar? Bir cümle hiçbir yere uymuyor.

texts.title: Does listening to a book count as reading?

options.label: a
options.body: None of that is possible at walking speed with a voice in your ear.

options.label: b
options.body: Whether that counts as the same thing depends on what you wanted from the book, which is a better question than the one we started with.

options.label: c
options.body: The question is not a silly one, and the people who ask it are usually the ones doing most of the listening.

options.label: d
options.body: That is the honest difference: half of your attention is on the road, the washing-up or the dog.

options.label: e
options.body: For a difficult book that is not a small advantage, because a good reader hands you the shape of a sentence for nothing.

options.label: f
options.body: The reading group meets in the back room of a café that closes at nine, which is why we never finish.

items.explain: Açılış cümlesi soruyu ve sorulma sıklığını veriyor: «about twice a year, and the answer they want is yes». (c) soruyu ciddiye alıp soranların kim olduğunu söylüyor, yani paragrafı kapatıyor.
Paragraf sesli okuyanın metni daha çok düşündüğünü söylüyor; (e) «that is not a small advantage» ile tam o üstünlüğe gönderme yapıp gerekçelendiriyor.
Önceki cümle okurken yapılanları sayıyor: durmak, «go back four lines and start again». (a) «None of that» ile o listeye gönderme yapıp dinlerken olanaksız olduğunu söylüyor.

Paragraf aynı anda başka iş yapıldığını söylüyor; (d) o başka işleri adlandırıyor: «the road, the washing-up or the dog». (a) da bir olanaksızlık bildiriyor ama okuma denetimiyle ilgili, dikkat bölünmesiyle değil.

Son cümle ikisinin ortak yanını veriyor: «a similar feeling of having been somewhere». (b) «Whether that counts as the same thing» ile oraya bağlanıp soruyu yeniden çerçeveliyor. (f) kafenin kapanış saatinden söz ediyor ve metinde okuma grubunun yeri hiç tartışılmıyor — hiçbir boşluğa uymayan cümle odur.

tasks.prompt: Read the text and complete gaps 21 to 25. Which word fits: a, b, c or d?
tasks.promptTr: Metni oku ve 21–25. boşlukları tamamla. Hangi sözcük uyar: a, b, c ya da d?

texts.title: What I tell students about their phones
texts.body:
Every year I am asked how to stop {{21}} at a phone while studying, and every year I give the same answer.

Do not try to use willpower. Willpower is what you have {{22}} the phone is in your pocket, and it runs out at about four in the afternoon.

Put the phone in another room. Students laugh at this {{23}} they try it, and then they tell me it was the only thing that worked.

If the phone has to stay with you because of a child or a job, say {{24}} loud which twenty minutes you will not look at it.

And do not measure the hours you spend. Measure {{25}} you finished, because that is what you actually wanted.

items.explain: `stop` fiilinden sonra bırakılan eylem `-ing` ile gelir: `stop looking`. `stop to look` «bakmak için durmak» demektir ve anlamı tam tersine çevirir.
Boşluk iki eşzamanlı durumu bağlıyor: telefon cepteyken sahip olduğun şey. `while` eşzamanlılığı verir; `until` bir sona, `since` bir başlangıca gönderir, `unless` ise koşulu olumsuzlar.
İki olay sırayla geliyor: önce gülüyorlar, deneyene kadar. `until` bu sınırı çizer; `so` sonuç, `although` karşıtlık bildirir ve `unless` koşulu olumsuzlar.
`out loud` sesli söylemeyi anlatan yerleşik bir öbektir. `up`, `on` ve `over` bu öbeği kurmaz ve `loud` ile birleşmez.
Boşluk `measure` fiilinin nesnesi olan bir ad cümleciği başlatıyor ve öncülü yok; bunu yalnız `what` yapar. `that` ve `which` bir öncüle bağlanır, `who` ise kişi ister.

tasks.prompt: Read the text and complete gaps 26 to 30. Write ONE word in each gap.
tasks.promptTr: Metni oku ve 26–30. boşlukları tamamla. Her boşluğa TEK bir sözcük yaz.

texts.title: What I have kept
texts.body:
I have been trying different ways of studying {{26}} January, and here is what I have kept.

I put the phone in another room, {{27}} sounds extreme until you try it.

I stopped counting hours. Hours are easy {{28}} count and they tell you nothing at all.

I write by hand in anything I want to remember {{29}} more than a week.

And I tell one person what I am going to do, {{30}} that I have to say it out loud.

items.explain: Başlangıç noktası `since` ile verilir: `since January`. `for` bir süre uzunluğu ister (`for six months`), ay adı değil.
Virgülden sonra bütün bir cümleye gönderme yapan ilgi adılı gerekiyor; bunu `which` yapar. `that` virgüllü ilgi cümlesinde kullanılmaz, `who` ise kişi ister.
`easy` sıfatından sonra eylem mastarla gelir: `easy to count`. `for counting` de mümkün olurdu ama boşluk tek sözcük ve `for` tek başına bu kalıbı kurmaz.
Süre uzunluğu `for` ile verilir: `for more than a week`. Metnin başındaki `since January` bir başlangıç noktasıydı; ikisi karıştırılmamalı.
Amaç `so that` ile bildirilir ve boşluğa gelen sözcük `that` ile birleşir: «so that I have to say it out loud». `because` sebep bildirir, amaç değil.

parts.instruction: This part has four tasks. You hear short extracts, conversations, some information and an interview. You hear every recording twice.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde dört görev var. Kısa parçalar, konuşmalar, bir bilgilendirme ve bir söyleşi dinleyeceksin. Her kaydı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

tasks.prompt: You hear seven short extracts. Choose a, b or c. You hear every extract twice.
tasks.promptTr: Yedi kısa parça dinleyeceksin. a, b ya da c'yi seç. Her parçayı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Okul velilere ileti bırakıyor.

segments.text: Hello, this is about the phone boxes. From Monday the boxes are at the classroom door and not at the school gate, so students keep their phones until the lesson starts. Nothing else changes. Ask your daughter to show you where the box is.

texts.situation: İki öğrenci ders çalışma süresini konuşuyor.

segments.text: How long did you study yesterday?
Six hours.
Six?
Well, I was at the desk for six hours. If you ask me what I finished, the answer is one page and a very clean desk.

texts.situation: Kütüphanede sessiz oda için anons yapılıyor.

segments.text: A reminder about the quiet room: phones on silent, and not face down on the table. If you need to take a call, the corridor is three metres away and nobody minds. The room is open until midnight, as always.

texts.situation: İki iş arkadaşı gece gelen bir iletiyi konuşuyor.

segments.text: Did you see my message at eleven last night?
I did, and I answered it at seven this morning.
You did not have to wait.
I know. But if I answer at midnight, you will answer at midnight, and then everybody does.

texts.situation: Bir konuşmacı dikkat üstüne konuşuyor.

segments.text: People tell me they cannot concentrate any more and they blame the phone. I ask them one question: where is it now? Nine times out of ten it is on the table, face down, which they think is the same as away. It is in the room. That is what matters.

texts.situation: Biri yazma kursu için arıyor.

segments.text: Is there a place on the typing course?
The Tuesday one is full. There is a new group on Thursdays from the fourth.
Same teacher?
Same teacher, same six weeks, and it is the same twenty euros.

texts.situation: Biri randevusu için ileti bırakıyor.

segments.text: Hi, it is about Thursday. I cannot come to the study-skills hour after all, because my shift has changed. Do not give the place away for good, though. Can I have the one in two weeks instead?

options: Whether phones are allowed at all
The lesson that the rule covers
items.explain: İleti tek değişikliği veriyor: «the boxes are at the classroom door and not at the school gate». Kural sürüyor: «Nothing else changes».

items.text: What is the second speaker admitting?
options: He did not go to the library
He studied for less than an hour
The hours do not show what he did
items.explain: Konuşmacı iki ölçüyü ayırıyor: «I was at the desk for six hours» ama bitirdiği «one page and a very clean desk».

items.text: What does the announcement ask people to do?
options: Leave their phones at the desk
items.explain: Anons yeri gösteriyor: «If you need to take a call, the corridor is three metres away». Oda gece yarısına kadar açık.

items.text: Why did the second speaker wait until the morning?
options: Because the phone was switched off
Because the message was not urgent
items.explain: Gerekçe zincirleme veriliyor: «if I answer at midnight, you will answer at midnight, and then everybody does». Telefonun kapalı olduğu söylenmiyor.

options: People should get rid of their phones
A phone on the table is still present
items.explain: Konuşmacı yanılgıyı adlandırıyor: yüzü kapalı telefonu uzakta sanıyorlar, oysa «It is in the room. That is what matters».

items.text: What is different about the Thursday group?
items.explain: Görevli aynı kalanları sayıyor: «Same teacher, same six weeks, and it is the same twenty euros». Geriye yalnız gün farkı kalıyor.

options: To change the time on Thursday
items.explain: İleti yerini bırakmıyor, erteliyor: «Do not give the place away for good, though. Can I have the one in two weeks instead?»

tasks.prompt: You hear six short conversations. What is the main point? Choose a, b or c. You hear every conversation twice.
tasks.promptTr: Altı kısa konuşma dinleyeceksin. Ana nokta nedir? a, b ya da c'yi seç. Her konuşmayı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: İki arkadaş okumaktan söz ediyor.

segments.text: I read forty pages last night.
That is a lot for you.
It is. The only thing I changed was leaving the phone in the kitchen. I have been telling myself for a year that I am too tired to read.

texts.situation: İki veli okulun yeni kuralını konuşuyor.

segments.text: The school takes the phones in now.
And?
My son says the first week was terrible and the fourth week was normal.
So it worked.
He also says nobody talks about it any more, which is the part I did not expect.

texts.situation: Radyoda bir dinleyici görüş bildiriyor.

segments.text: I am not against listening to books. I listened to nine last year and I could tell you what happens in all of them. What I cannot do is stop and read a sentence twice, and for some books that is the whole point.

texts.situation: Sunucu bir yılını telefonsuz geçiren kişiyle konuşuyor.

segments.text: You went a whole year without a smartphone.
I did.
Everybody says it changed their life.
Mine came back almost exactly as it was, except that I now know how to get to places without being told.

texts.situation: İki arkadaş yazma kursunu tartışıyor.

segments.text: Six weeks of typing lessons at my age.
Why not?
Because I have typed with two fingers for thirty years and it works.
It works at half the speed. You told me last month that the forms take you all Friday.

texts.situation: İki öğrenci bir yöntemi konuşuyor.

segments.text: I put my phone in the other room and I still did nothing for two hours.
So it does not work.
It works for me. But if the thing you are avoiding is the essay, the phone was never the problem.

items.text: What is the first speaker doing?
items.explain: Konuşmacı kendi açıklamasını çürütüyor: «I have been telling myself for a year that I am too tired to read», oysa değişen tek şey telefonun yeri.

options: The rule stopped being an issue
The son is against the rule
The school will change the rule again
items.explain: Baba iki ölçüt veriyor: «the fourth week was normal» ve «nobody talks about it any more». Oğlunun karşı çıktığı söylenmiyor.
Konuşmacı önce reddi eliyor: «I am not against listening to books», sonra sınırı adlandırıyor: «What I cannot do is stop and read a sentence twice».

items.text: What is the second speaker doing?
options: Recommending a year without a phone
Explaining why she gave up early
items.explain: Sunucu büyük iddiayı aktarıyor: «Everybody says it changed their life». Konuşmacı onu küçültüyor: «Mine came back almost exactly as it was».

items.text: What is the second speaker doing?
options: Agreeing that the course is a bad idea
Using the other person's own words against him
Offering to fill in the forms for him
items.explain: Konuşmacı karşı tarafın daha önce söylediğini hatırlatıyor: «You told me last month that the forms take you all Friday».

items.text: What does the second speaker suggest?
options: The phone is not the real difficulty here
The first speaker should try a longer time
items.explain: Konuşmacı yöntemi savunup teşhisi ayırıyor: «if the thing you are avoiding is the essay, the phone was never the problem».

tasks.prompt: You hear information about a study-skills service. Complete the notes, questions 14 to 19. Write ONE or TWO words or a number in each gap. You hear the information twice.
tasks.promptTr: Bir çalışma becerileri hizmeti hakkında bilgi dinleyeceksin. 14–19. maddelerdeki notları tamamla. Her boşluğa BİR ya da İKİ sözcük veya bir sayı yaz. Kaydı iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Bir görevli çalışma becerileri saatini anlatıyor.

segments.text: Good afternoon. The study-skills hour runs on a Thursday, between two and five. It is free and you book it online, but you must bring two weeks of your own notes; we do not work from memory. There are four advisers and each hour is with one person. Book at least five days before, and if you cannot come, cancel by the Monday. The room is on the second floor, next to the lift.

texts.title: Study-skills hour — notes

items.explain: Kayıt günü veriyor: «The study-skills hour runs on a Thursday». Pazartesi iptal günü, gün değil.
Kayıt koşulu gerekçesiyle veriyor: «you must bring two weeks of your own notes; we do not work from memory».
«There are four advisers and each hour is with one person» — danışman sayısı dört, görüşmedeki kişi sayısı bir.
«Book at least five days before» — en az beş gün. İki ile beş arası saat aralığı, gün sayısı değil.
«if you cannot come, cancel by the Monday» — iptal için son gün. Perşembe hizmetin kendi günü.
«The room is on the second floor, next to the lift» — kat numarası. Asansör yer tarifi, kat değil.

tasks.prompt: You hear an interview with a man who spent a year without a smartphone. Choose a, b or c for questions 20 to 25. You hear the interview twice.
tasks.promptTr: Bir yılını akıllı telefonsuz geçiren bir adamla söyleşi dinleyeceksin. 20–25. maddeler için a, b ya da c'yi seç. Söyleşiyi iki kez dinleyebilirsin.

texts.situation: Bir sunucu, bir yıl akıllı telefon kullanmayan Ondrej ile konuşuyor.

segments.text: A year without a smartphone. Whose idea was it?
My own, and I want to be honest: it was partly showing off. I told about forty people before I started, which is the only reason I lasted past March.
What was the first month like?
Boring, and not in the good way that people describe. I stood at bus stops with nothing to do and I did not have a single deep thought. I looked at the timetable.
When did it get easier?

Around week seven, and the reason is dull. I had worked out the four or five things the phone had actually been doing for me: maps, tickets, the bank, messages from my mother. Then I had found a way to do each of them.
What did you gain?
Less than the books promise. I read three more books than the year before, which is not nothing, but it is not a new person either. The real change is that I can find my way around this city now.
And what did you lose?
Time, mostly. Everything took longer and some of that was pure waste. I also missed two invitations, and one of them mattered.
Do you have a smartphone now?
I do, since last August. People find that disappointing, as if the year had been a failure.
Was it?
No. I use it about a third as much as I used to, and I do not think that would have happened any other way. The year was not the point; week seven was the point.

items.text: Why did Ondrej tell so many people about his plan?
options: He wanted others to do it with him
Telling them made it hard to stop
A friend had asked him to write about it
items.explain: Ondrej etkisini kendisi söylüyor: «I told about forty people before I started, which is the only reason I lasted past March».

items.text: What does he say about the first month?
options: It was dull in an ordinary way
It gave him time to think deeply
It was easier than he had expected
items.explain: Ondrej beklenen anlatıyı reddediyor: «Boring, and not in the good way that people describe … I did not have a single deep thought».

items.text: Why did week seven change things?
options: He had got used to being bored
He had bought a simple phone
He had replaced each thing the phone did
items.explain: Ondrej dönüşü açıklıyor: «I had worked out the four or five things the phone had actually been doing for me» — harita, bilet, banka, annesinden gelen iletiler — «Then I had found a way to do each of them».

items.text: What does he say about reading?
options: He read far more than in any other year
Three extra books is real but small
items.explain: Ondrej sayıyı verip büyüklüğünü ölçüyor: «I read three more books than the year before, which is not nothing, but it is not a new person either».
Ondrej kaybı sayıyor: «Time, mostly … I also missed two invitations». Şehirde yolunu bulmak kayıp değil kazanç: «I can find my way around this city now».

items.text: How does he judge the year now?
options: As a failure, since he has a phone again
As something he would repeat every year
As worth it for what it taught him
items.explain: Ondrej başarısızlık okumasını reddediyor ve ölçütünü veriyor: «I use it about a third as much as I used to» ve «week seven was the point».

parts.instruction: This part has two tasks: an email and an article.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde iki görev var: bir e-posta ve bir yazı.

tasks.prompt: You are on an evening course that promised no phones in the room, and about half the group uses them all through the lesson. Write an email to the teacher. Write about 100 words and cover all the points.
tasks.promptTr: Odada telefon kullanılmayacağı sözü verilen bir akşam kursundasın ve grubun yaklaşık yarısı ders boyunca telefon kullanıyor. Öğretmene bir e-posta yaz. Yaklaşık 100 kelime, bütün maddeleri işle.

points.de: Say which course you are on and what was promised.
points.tr: Hangi kursta olduğunu ve ne söz verildiğini söyle.

points.de: Describe what actually happens, with one example.
points.tr: Gerçekte ne olduğunu bir örnekle anlat.

points.de: Ask for one clear change, not a general complaint.
points.tr: Genel bir şikâyet değil, tek ve açık bir değişiklik iste.

rubric.sample:
Dear Ms Vale,

I am in the Tuesday photography group that started on 6 January. The information sheet said that phones would stay in bags during the lesson.

In practice about half the group has a phone on the table for the whole two hours. Last week the person next to me answered three calls in the room, and I lost most of the second exercise.

I am not asking you to take anybody's phone away. Could you say the rule out loud at the start of each lesson, as you did in week one?

Thank you for a course I am otherwise enjoying.

Best wishes,
Nadia Roth
criteria: Üç içerik noktasının üçü de işlendi mi?
Somut bir örnek verildi mi, yoksa yalnız genel yakınma mı var?
İstenen değişiklik tek ve uygulanabilir mi?
Kayıt kibar mı? Suçlayıcı bir dile kaymış mı?
Yaklaşık 100 kelime yazıldı mı?

tasks.prompt: Write an article for a website with this title: "A rule I made for myself and broke". Say what the rule was, why you made it and what happened. Write about 100 words.
tasks.promptTr: Bir internet sitesi için şu başlıkla bir yazı yaz: "Kendime koyup çiğnediğim bir kural". Kuralın ne olduğunu, neden koyduğunu ve ne olduğunu yaz. Yaklaşık 100 kelime.

points.de: Say what the rule was.
Say why you made it.
Say what happened in the end.

rubric.sample:
My rule was simple: no phone in the bedroom. I bought a clock for four euros so that I had no excuse.

I made the rule because I was reading the news at one in the morning and then telling my colleagues I had slept badly, as if it were the weather.

It worked for five weeks. Then my sister was in hospital and the phone came back to the bedside table, which was the right decision. It never left again.

What I have kept is smaller and it still helps: the phone is in the room, but it is in a drawer.
criteria: Üç içerik noktasının üçü de işlendi mi?
Kural somut mu, yoksa genel bir niyet mi?
Kuralın çiğnenme anı anlatıldı mı, yoksa yalnız sonuç mu var?
Geçmiş zaman ve present perfect doğru ayrıldı mı?
Yaklaşık 100 kelime yazıldı mı?

parts.instruction: This part has four tasks: an interview, a long turn, a task we do together, and a general conversation.
parts.instructionTr: Bu bölümde dört görev var: söyleşi, tek başına konuşma, birlikte yapılan bir görev ve genel sohbet.

tasks.prompt: I ask you some questions about how you study or work and about your phone.
tasks.promptTr: Sana nasıl çalıştığın ve telefonun hakkında sorular soracağım.

exchange.de: Good afternoon. Where and when do you work or study best?
exchange.tr: İyi günler. En iyi nerede ve ne zaman çalışıyorsun?

exchange.hint: Yeri ve saati anlat, bir gerekçe ver.
exchange.expect: bir alışkanlığı yer ve zaman bilgisiyle anlatmak

exchange.de: Thank you. Have you ever tried to change the way you study?
exchange.tr: Teşekkürler. Çalışma biçimini değiştirmeyi hiç denedin mi?

exchange.hint: Present perfect ya da `used to` ile bir denemeyi anlat.
exchange.expect: geçmişteki bir denemeyi ve sonucunu anlatmak

exchange.de: And if you had to work without a phone for a month, what would be hardest?
exchange.tr: Bir ay telefonsuz çalışmak zorunda kalsan en zoru ne olurdu?

exchange.hint: Koşul kipiyle cevapla ve gerekçelendir.
exchange.expect: ikinci tip koşul cümlesiyle bir varsayım kurmak

points.de: describe a habit with place and time
points.tr: Bir alışkanlığı yer ve zamanla anlatmak

points.de: describe an attempt to change something
use a second conditional

rubric.sample: I work best at the kitchen table between six and eight in the morning, mostly because nobody in the flat is awake. I have tried studying in the evening and it never lasts more than a week. Last year I put my phone in a drawer while I worked, and for about a month it made a real difference. If I had to work without a phone for a month, the hardest part would be train tickets, because everything I need is in that one app.
criteria: İlk cevapta yer ve zaman verildi mi?
Deneme somut mu anlatıldı, sonucu söylendi mi?
Son cevapta ikinci tip koşul kuruldu mu?
Cevaplar geliştirildi mi, tek cümlede mi kaldı?

tasks.prompt: Talk on your own for about one minute. Compare these two ways of working: in a silent room on your own, or in a busy place with other people around you. Say which suits you and why.
tasks.promptTr: Yaklaşık bir dakika tek başına konuş. Çalışmanın şu iki yolunu karşılaştır: tek başına sessiz bir odada mı, yoksa çevrende insanlar olan kalabalık bir yerde mi? Hangisinin sana uyduğunu ve nedenini söyle.

points.de: compare the two ways
say which suits you and why
points.tr: Hangisinin sana uyduğunu ve nedenini söyle

points.de: mention one disadvantage of your choice
points.tr: Seçtiğin yolun bir olumsuz yanını da söyle

rubric.sample: A silent room gives you everything except a reason to stay in it. Nobody sees you leave after twenty minutes. A busy place is noisier, and the noise is the price you pay for being watched by strangers who do not care about you at all. That second thing works on me: I get more done in a café than at home, although the coffee costs about thirty euros a month. The disadvantage is that I cannot read anything difficult there. Anything that needs a second look has to be done at the kitchen table.
criteria: İki yol da gerçekten karşılaştırıldı mı?
Karşılaştırma yapıları kullanıldı mı? (except, although, the price you pay)
Seçim gerekçelendirildi mi?
Seçilen yolun olumsuz yanı da söylendi mi?
Bir dakika kesintisiz konuşuldu mu?

tasks.prompt: Our six-week evening course has to agree on one rule about phones in the room. Talk with me and agree on the wording.
tasks.promptTr: Altı haftalık akşam kursumuzun odadaki telefonlar için tek bir kural üzerinde anlaşması gerekiyor. Benimle konuş ve kuralın nasıl yazılacağında anlaş.

exchange.de: The simplest rule is: no phones in the room at all. Would you sign that?
exchange.tr: En basit kural şu: odada hiç telefon olmasın. Buna imza atar mısın?

exchange.hint: Öneriye gerekçeli karşılık ver: kabul et ya da değiştir.
exchange.expect: bir öneriye gerekçeli karşılık vermek

exchange.de: But two people in the group have small children at home and they need to be reachable. Does the rule still work?
exchange.tr: Ama gruptaki iki kişinin evde küçük çocuğu var ve ulaşılabilir olmaları gerekiyor. Kural yine de işler mi?

exchange.hint: Bu duruma somut bir istisna öner ve nasıl işleyeceğini söyle.
exchange.expect: bir kısıtı karşılayan somut bir istisna önermek

exchange.de: Good. Say the rule as we would write it on the sheet.
exchange.tr: Güzel. Kuralı kâğıda yazacağımız gibi söyle.

exchange.hint: Kuralı tek tek ve uygulanabilir biçimde söyle.
exchange.expect: varılan kuralı açık ve uygulanabilir biçimde ifade etmek

points.de: respond to a proposal with a reason
make an exception that fits a real need
points.tr: Gerçek bir gereksinimi karşılayan bir istisna kurmak

points.de: state the agreed rule clearly

rubric.sample: I would not sign that, because a rule nobody can keep is worse than no rule. You are right that two people have to be reachable, so let us say this: phones stay in bags on silent, and anybody who is waiting for a call sits by the door and takes it outside. On the sheet: phones in bags, on silent; calls taken in the corridor; if you are expecting one, tell us at the start of the lesson.
criteria: İlk öneriye gerekçeli bir karşılık verildi mi?
İstisna gerçek gereksinimi karşılıyor mu?
Sonunda kural açık ve uygulanabilir biçimde söylendi mi?
Karşı tarafın söylediğine gönderme yapıldı mı?

tasks.prompt: We talk a little more about the same topic: whether schools should collect phones at the door.
tasks.promptTr: Aynı konu üzerine biraz daha konuşuyoruz: okullar telefonları kapıda toplamalı mı.

exchange.de: Some schools now put every phone in a box for the whole day. Is that going too far?
exchange.tr: Bazı okullar artık bütün gün boyunca her telefonu bir kutuya koyuyor. Bu fazla mı?

exchange.hint: Görüşünü söyle ve bir örnek ver.
exchange.expect: genel bir soruya görüş bildirmek ve örneklendirmek

exchange.de: Others say that a rule taken away from you teaches you nothing about deciding for yourself. Would you agree?
exchange.tr: Kimileri de senden alınmış bir kuralın kendi kararını vermeyi öğretmediğini söylüyor. Katılır mısın?

exchange.hint: Kısmen katıl ya da karşı çık; iki yanı da anmaya çalış.
